title: Diabetic Foot: A Small Wound Can Become A Life-Disrupting Complication
dek: Did you know that people living with diabetes are at risk of developing serious foot complications that can sometimes lead to gangrene or amputation causing immobility?

cover.alt: WARNING SIGNS YOU SHOULD NEVER IGNORE

author: a_team

text.t: Diabetic Foot Complications Often Develop Due To Three Major Factors:

blocks.text: Reduced sensation can make it difficult to notice cuts, blisters, or injuries.
Restricted arterial blood flow reduces the oxygen and nutrients reaching foot tissues, affecting wound healing.
Even a minor wound can develop into a serious ulcer or infection if not identified and treated promptly.

text.t: WARNING SIGNS YOU SHOULD NEVER IGNORE

items: Cold feet or changes in skin colour
Bacterial infection leading to life dangering Sepsis

text.t: HOW CAN YOU PROTECT YOUR FEET?

items: Keep your feet clean and dry.
Maintain blood sugar, blood pressure, and cholesterol within your prescribed targets.
Seek professional medical advice promptly if you notice any wound or unusual change.
Sedentary life style aggravates the problem and return venous flow & arterial flow tend to get stagnant. To prevent such a condition, its important to walk 20 – 30 minutes everyday.
